sources.snippet: Dennis Haskins, US actor who played Mr Belding in Saved by the Bell, dies aged 75  theguardian.com
sources.title: Dennis Haskins, US actor who played Mr Belding in Saved by the Bell, dies aged 75 - theguardian.com

sources.snippet:
Agent calls death of Haskins, who played the school principal in three programs, ‘a tragic loss’

The US actor Dennis Haskins – most known for co-starring in the popular Saved by the Bell television series franchise – has died, his agent confirmed on Tuesday. He was 75.

Alluding to Haskins’ Saved by the Bell character, the fictional high school principal Mr Richard Belding, agent Jay Schachter said in a statement: “It’s a tragic loss. Everyone loved Mr Belding, and those of us who got to know Dennis loved him even more.

sources.snippet: O líder parlamentar do PSD apela aos partidos da oposição para viabilizarem o Orçamento do Estado. O PS e o Chega dizem que o documento não responde ao problema do aumento do custo de vida.
sources.title: OE2027. Governo ouve partidos da oposição

sources.snippet: O PS acusa o Governo de não incluir medidas de apoio ao custo de vida, no próximo Orçamento do Estado. Já o Chega diz que a proposta da tutela não baixa impostos. O líder parlamentar do PSD defende que o Executivo tem anunciado medidas para "ajudar as famílias".
